name: Análisis de Estabilización
algorithm: Stabilization Artifact — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method detects video stabilization artifacts for forensic analysis:

1. **Cámara Movimiento Estimación**: Global camera motion is estimated from background feature tracking — translation, rotation, and zoom components per frame. The raw (unstabilized) camera motion trajectory is reconstructed.

2. **Stabilization Artefacto Detección**: Video stabilization smooths camera motion by applying compensating transforms. This produces characteristic artifacts: (a) cropped borders (stabilization reduces effective field of view), (b) warping residuals from rolling shutter correction, (c) motion blur inconsistent with the displayed (stabilized) motion.

3. **Double Stabilization Detección**: If a deepfake video is stabilized and then the original footage was also stabilized, double-stabilization produces characteristic artifacts: excessive border cropping, over-smoothed motion (unnatural zero jitter), and cumulative warping residuals.

4. **Rostro - Background Movimiento Consistencia**: After de-stabilization, the apparent motion of the face and background should be consistent with the same camera motion. If the face was generated and composited, its motion may not match the camera motion recovered from the background, creating a detectable motion inconsistency.

5. **Stabilization History Análisis**: The method estimates whether and how many times the video was stabilized. Each stabilization pass leaves a characteristic imprint on the motion trajectory (reduced high-frequency components). Multiple stabilization passes indicate the video has been processed multiple times — consistent with a manipulation → re-stabilization pipeline.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante stabilization artifact analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Amerini, I. et al. (2019). Deepfake Video Detection through Optical Flow based CNN. ICCV Workshop.
Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
